en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a stone bench and wall structure called the 'Zillerbank' along a wooded path in a valley. A woman in early 20th‑century dress and hat stands in front of the curved stone bench, which is built into a hillside and features a central plaque and small gabled top. Bare trees cover the sloping forest behind. Printed captions in German identify the location as Kötzschenbroda–Lößnitzgrund and name the bench Zillerbank, with a publisher credit at the bottom.
